mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_attempt ( quiz_id, student_id, score, total_marks, correct_count, wrong_count, submitted_at, duration_seconds ) VALUES ( #{quizId}, #{studentId}, #{score}, #{totalMarks}, #{correctCount}, #{wrongCount}, #{submittedAt}, #{durationSeconds} )
mapper.select: SELECT attempt_id, quiz_id, student_id, score, total_marks, correct_count, wrong_count, submitted_at, duration_seconds FROM quiz_attempt WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} LIMIT 1

SELECT qa.attempt_id, qa.quiz_id, q.title AS quiz_title, qa.student_id, a.full_name AS student_name, qa.score, qa.total_marks, qa.correct_count, qa.wrong_count, qa.submitted_at, qa.duration_seconds FROM quiz_attempt qa LEFT JOIN quiz q ON qa.quiz_id = q.quiz_id LEFT JOIN account a ON qa.student_id = a.account_id WHERE qa.attempt_id = #{attemptId} LIMIT 1

SELECT qa.attempt_id, qa.quiz_id, q.title AS quiz_title, c.course_id, c.title AS course_title, qa.score, qa.total_marks, qa.submitted_at, qa.duration_seconds FROM quiz_attempt qa LEFT JOIN quiz q ON qa.quiz_id = q.quiz_id LEFT JOIN course c ON q.course_id = c.course_id WHERE qa.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY qa.submitted_at DESC
SELECT attempt_id, quiz_id, student_id, score, total_marks, correct_count, wrong_count, submitted_at, duration_seconds FROM quiz_attempt WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} ORDER BY submitted_at DESC
